SELECT
  DATE '2026-09-01' AS outlook_period_start,
  DATE '2026-09-30' AS outlook_period_end,
  DATE '2026-09-08' AS outlook_as_of,
  COUNT(*) AS outlook_row_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(Date) <= DATE '2026-09-08'
    THEN Sales1_R ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue_through_as_of,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(Date) > DATE '2026-09-08'
    THEN Sales1_R ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue_after_as_of,
  COALESCE(SUM(Sales1_R), 0) AS revenue_in_period
FROM `skin1004-319714.Sales_Integration.SALES_ALL_Backup`
WHERE Date >= DATETIME '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
  AND Date < DATETIME '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
LIMIT 1000
